narr: A stationary front was draped just northwest of the area, while southwesterly flow aloft was adding moisture to the vertical column. Early evening convection produced localized flash flooding.
ev: Water was covering roads near the intersection of Martin Mill Pike and Tipton Station Road, and the intersection of Brown Road and Rudder Road. One car was stranded in water in a nearby subdivision. Tipton Station Road was also flooded near South Doyle High School.
Roads flooded at the intersection of Neubert Springs Road and West Ford Valley Road.
